title_en: Russian strikes wound nine and damage Ukraine's power network ahead of talks
title_zh: 会谈前俄罗斯发动袭击造成九人受伤并破坏乌克兰电力网络
summary: The attacks come before Ukrainian and Russian delegations are due to take part in trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi next week.
summary_zh: 这些袭击发生在乌克兰和俄罗斯代表团下周参加阿布扎比三边会谈之前。
body_en: By Olivia Ireland and Dan Johnson , Reporting from in Kyiv
Overnight drone and ballistic missile attacks damaged Ukrainian energy infrastructure, President Volodymyr Zelenskyhas said, causing blackouts and disrupting water supplies.
Zelensky said 12 Ukrainian regions came under attack with the capital Kyiv hit hardest.
Nine people are reported to have been hurt across the country, including one child, in the wave of attacks that consisted of more than 30 ballistic missiles and over 170 drones.
The attacks come before Ukrainian and Russian delegations are due to take part in trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi next week.
Zelensky wrote on Telegram , external that Moscow was preparing for the talks by launching attacks on Ukraine's "critical infrastructure".
Temperatures are dropping in Ukraine, and parts of the country have had the first winter snow.

"The situation in the capital is difficult, with disruptions to electricity, water, and heating supplies. Residential buildings, the North Bridge, and a kindergarten have been damaged," Zelensky said.
"In the Kyiv region, there were strikes on substations that connect the Rivne and Khmelnytsky nuclear power plants to Kyiv and central Ukraine."

In his latest update, Kyiv's Mayor Vitali Klitschko said the city's water supply system is back to operating normally. He also said around 60% of the city's apartment buildings were connected to the heating system.
The energy minister, Denys Shmyhal, said there were power cuts in five regions but did not say how many homes were affected.
Zelensky added that beyond Kyiv, substations were damaged in Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Kharkiv and Dnipro regions.
The latest attacks come after US First Lady Melania Trump hosted Russian and Ukrainian delegations at the White House on Thursday.
She called for a "more enduring" ceasefire in Ukraine following a truce last week in the southern region of Kherson.

She thanked both Zelensky and Russian President Vladimir Putin, making no reference to the origins of the war, which began when Putin launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, which has caused thousands of civilian casualties and the displacement of millions.

Hundreds of residents of the Russian-occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky facing starvation and constant bombardment were able to evacuate during a six-day ceasefire , which both Moscow and Kyiv credited Trump with brokering.
"The lives of innocent people must transcend the division of war. I hope Oleshky inspires greater peace," she said.
Earlier this week, a number of people were killed when glide bombs hit an aid centre near Zaporizhzhia , with the death toll rising to 55 as teams search deeper into the ruins.
Zelensky added in his Telegram post on Saturday following the latest attacks that Ukraine was counting on increased bilateral support from the United States.
He wrote: "We are counting on unity between both parties on issues of security, support for Ukraine, condemnation of Russian aggression, and increased sanctions pressure on Putin.
body_zh: 奥利维亚·爱尔兰和丹·约翰逊，基辅报道
总统泽连斯基表示，夜间无人机和弹道导弹袭击破坏了乌克兰能源基础设施，导致停电和供水中断。
泽连斯基表示，乌克兰12个地区遭受袭击，其中首都基辅受灾最严重。
据报道，在这波由 30 多枚弹道导弹和 170 多架无人机组成的袭击浪潮中，全国有 9 人受伤，其中包括一名儿童。
这些袭击发生在乌克兰和俄罗斯代表团下周参加阿布扎比三边会谈之前。
泽伦斯基在 Telegram 上撰文称，莫斯科正在通过对乌克兰的“关键基础设施”发动攻击来为会谈做准备。
乌克兰气温正在下降，该国部分地区迎来了冬季的第一场雪。
“首都的情况很困难，电力、水和供暖供应中断。住宅楼、北桥和一所幼儿园遭到破坏，”泽伦斯基说。
“在基辅地区，连接罗夫诺和赫梅利尼茨基核电站与基辅和乌克兰中部的变电站发生了罢工。”
基辅市长维塔利·克里琴科在最新更新中表示，该市的供水系统已恢复正常运行。他还表示，该市约 60% 的公寓楼都连接了供暖系统。
能源部长丹尼斯·什米哈尔表示，五个地区停电，但没有透露有多少家庭受到影响。
泽伦斯基补充说，在基辅以外，文尼察、日托米尔、里夫内、哈尔科夫和第聂伯罗地区的变电站遭到破坏。
最近的袭击发生在美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普周四在白宫接待俄罗斯和乌克兰代表团之后。
上周在赫尔松南部地区停火后，她呼吁乌克兰实现“更持久”的停火。
她感谢泽伦斯基和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，但没有提及战争的起源。这场战争始于普京于 2022 年 2 月对乌克兰发动全面入侵，造成数千平民伤亡和数百万人流离失所。
俄罗斯占领的乌克兰城镇奥列什基的数百名面临饥饿和持续轰炸的居民在为期六天的停火期间得以撤离，莫斯科和基辅都将停火归功于特朗普的斡旋。
“无辜人民的生命必须超越战争的界限。我希望奥列什基能够激发更大的和平，”她说。
本周早些时候，滑翔炸弹袭击了扎波罗热附近的一个援助中心，造成多人死亡，随着救援人员深入废墟进行搜索，死亡人数上升至 55 人。
泽伦斯基在周六的电报帖子中补充道，在最近的袭击事件发生后，乌克兰希望美国能够增加双边支持。
他写道：“我们指望双方在安全问题上团结一致，支持乌克兰，谴责俄罗斯的侵略，并加大对普京的制裁压力。

title_en: What we know so far after Krakow gun attack
title_zh: 克拉科夫枪击事件后我们目前所知道的
summary: Six people were killed in a random shooting in the city's main square, and three bodies were later found at his home.
summary_zh: 该市主要广场发生随机枪击事件，造成六人死亡，后来在他家中发现了三具尸体。
body_en: Krakow shooting: What we know about gun attack in Poland - BBC News
At least six people were killed and several others injured when a gunman suspected to have ties to the far-right opened fire in central Krakow, the second largest city in Poland.
Three bodies were found at his home when it was searched by police. Here's everything we know so far.
The attack began shortly before 15:00 local time (14:00 GMT) in Krakow's Main Market Square, the bustling central point of the city.
Police said a man drove into the square before beginning to fire "at random people from his car".
Footage from the scene shows scenes of panic as people fled, with the sound of gunfire clearly heard.
A passing tram was shot at during the apparently random attack, shattering windows but no passengers were injured.
Armed officers raced to the scene and engaged in a gunfight with the attacker, who was shot within three minutes of the attack beginning, preventing a further massacre, officials said.
The gunman was shot but is alive and has been arrested.
Distressing footage authenticated by BBC Verify shows the moment a police officer confronts the suspect on the ground before firing his weapon several times.
The officer then falls to the ground, apparently having been injured himself.
Shop windows in the square have signs of damage, seemingly from bullets, with glass shards scattered along the floor.
City officials have urged people who live in the city and tourists to stay away from the area while an investigation continues.

The suspect's car, found at the intersection of Dietla and Stradomska streets, was checked for possible explosive devices, police said, but none were found. Residents of nearby buildings had been evacuated while the operation was under way.
Six people - four women and two men - are confirmed to have been killed, including a British national. Three victims are Polish and two have not been identified.

Sixteen people, including five foreigners and the attacker, were taken to hospital. Among those being treated are two police officers who were shot while detaining the attacker. The interior ministry later said they were from Britain, Austria, Russia, Germany and Portugal.
Poland's Prime Minister Donald Tusk later named the injured officers as Senior Constable Jakub Kulik and Senior Constable Artur Morański.
Tusk said three bodies - two women and one man - were found at the gunman's house when it was searched after the attack.

One of the police officers was described as being in a "very critical condition" by a Polish government minister after being shot three times while arresting the attacker. The officer is undergoing surgery, he added.
Polish authorities have not confirmed the names and ages of the other victims.
body_zh: 克拉科夫枪击事件：我们对波兰枪击事件的了解 -_澳门赌博平台
一名疑似与极右翼分子有联系的枪手在波兰第二大城市克拉科夫市中心开枪，造成至少六人死亡，多人受伤。
警方搜查其家时，发现三具尸体。这是迄今为止我们所知道的一切。
袭击于当地时间 15:00（格林尼治标准时间 14:00）前不久在克拉科夫的主要集市广场（该市繁华的中心点）开始。
警方称，一名男子开车进入广场，然后开始“从车内随机开枪”。
现场视频显示，人们四散逃离，枪声清晰可闻。
一辆路过的电车在这起看似随机的袭击中遭到枪击，窗户被震碎，但没有乘客受伤。
官员称，武装警察赶到现场并与袭击者发生枪战，袭击开始后三分钟内，袭击者被枪杀，避免了进一步的屠杀。
枪手被枪杀，但还活着并已被捕。
经 BBC Verify 认证的令人痛心的镜头显示，一名警察在地上与嫌疑人对峙，然后多次开枪。
这名警官随后倒地，显然自己也受伤了。
广场上商店的窗户有损坏的迹象，似乎是被子弹击中的，玻璃碎片散落在地板上。
市政府官员敦促该市居民和游客在调查继续期间远离该地区。
警方称，在 Dietla 街和 Stradomska 街的交叉口发现了嫌疑人的汽车，并检查了是否有爆炸装置，但没有发现任何东西。行动进行期间，附近建筑物的居民已被疏散。
确认有六人（四名女性和两名男性）被杀，其中包括一名英国国民。三名受害者是波兰人，其中两人身份不明。
包括五名外国人和袭击者在内的十六人被送往医院。接受治疗的人中有两名警察，他们在拘留袭击者时被枪杀。内政部后来表示，他们来自英国、奥地利、俄罗斯、德国和葡萄牙。
波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克后来将受伤警员命名为高级警员雅库布·库利克和高级警员阿图尔·莫兰斯基。
图斯克说，袭击发生后，在枪手的家中搜查时发现了三具尸体——两女一男。
波兰政府部长称其中一名警察在逮捕袭击者时中弹三枪，目前情况“非常危急”。他补充说，这名警官正在接受手术。
波兰当局尚未确认其他受害者的姓名和年龄。

title_en: New Zealand faces weeks of uncertainty with election ‘too close to call’
title_zh: 新西兰面临数周的不确定性，选举“势均力敌”
summary: National party will be largest in parliament but ultimate shape of next government won’t be settled for some time New Zealand could be facing a weeks-long wait to know the shape of its next government, after its nail-biting election failed to hand a decisive v
summary_zh: 国家党将成为议会中最大的政党，但下一届政府的最终形式将在一段时间内无法确定，新西兰可能面临几周的时间-
body_en: National party will be largest in parliament but ultimate shape of next government won’t be settled for some time

New Zealand could be facing a weeks-long wait to know the shape of its next government, after its nail-biting election failed to hand a decisive victory to either the incumbent rightwing coalition or opposition left bloc.

On preliminary results, the centre-right National party, led by the prime minister, Christopher Luxon , managed to secure enough seats to govern alongside its traditional coalition partners, the libertarian Act and populist New Zealand First parties.

But with some seats won by very slim margins, and special votes yet to be counted, that success is precarious, resulting in an election too close to call until official results are released on 27 November.

Special votes include overseas votes and ballots cast outside a voter’s electorate. In 2023, 600,000 such votes were made, 21% of the total. These votes tend to favour the left – in 2023, special votes resulted in Te Pāti Māori (the Māori party) and the Greens gaining three seats between them.

With nearly 100% of the regular votes counted on Saturday night, National secured 42 seats, Act 13 and New Zealand First 12. The combined 67-seat majority is wafer thin, with the left bloc just three seats behind.

Speaking to a room full of the party faithful at Auckland’s Viaduct events centre just before midnight, Luxon said the results were “too close to call” and the special votes would need to be counted before negotiations could begin.
National was still the largest party in parliament, he said, and had “a pathway to forming the next government”. National pipped Labour by 0.02% in the party vote.

Labour, led by Chris Hipkins , secured 35 seats, while its traditional coalition partners the Greens won 16 and Te Pāti Māori five. Even with the seven seats from the centrist newcomer party, Opportunity, the left bloc is three seats short of forming a government.
Before a rowdy crowd of supporters at the Cosmopolitan Club in Upper Hutt, north of Wellington, Hipkins joked that New Zealand had spoken but “it may take a bit longer to work out what they’ve said”.

“As things stand tonight, it is clear that we are not going to know the shape of our next government for a little while longer yet,” Hipkins said, promising that Labour would get “straight to work” should the final count land in its favour.

The collapse of the two major parties, amid a sluggish economy and stubbornly high ⁠inflation, is feeding record support for the smaller parties, including Act, New Zealand First and the Greens. It is also helped propel Opportunity into parliament for the first time.

Opinion polls in the lead-up to the election had Opportunity placed to become the kingmaker. At this stage, the right bloc does not need the party to govern, but if special votes change the landscape, its predicted role could come to fruition.

Currently at 5.9%, the centrist party has met the threshold needed to enter parliament, a historic first. Since New Zealand adopted the mixed-member proportional (MMP) electoral system in 1996, no new party has been able to meet that threshold – all the other minor parties have been born from MPs or groups splintering from larger parties.
The party’s leader, Qiulae Wong, told her supporters in Auckland she was “stoked”.
“It’s looking very promising for us,” she said. “Let’s just see how the rest of the votes fall.”
New Zealand heads for election cliffhanger with minor party cast as kingmaker
In New Zealand, voters cast two votes: one for an electorate MP and one for a party. The system is meant to produce a parliament that reflects each party’s share of the nationwide vote.
However, if New Zealanders vote for more electorate MPs from a particular party than their party vote would entitle them to, they get to keep the extra MPs in what is called an overhang.
body_zh: 国家党将在议会中占据最大席位，但下一届政府的最终形式将在一段时间内无法确定
在令人紧张的选举未能让现任右翼联盟或反对派左翼集团取得决定性胜利后，新西兰可能面临长达数周的等待，以了解下一届政府的组成。
初步结果显示，总理克里斯托弗·卢克森 (Christopher Luxon) 领导的中右翼国家党成功获得了足够的席位，与其传统的联盟伙伴、自由主义法案党和民粹主义的新西兰优先党一起执政。
但由于一些席位以微弱优势赢得，而且特别选票尚未清点，这种成功是不稳定​​的，导致选举在 11 月 27 日正式结果公布之前难以预测。
特别投票包括海外投票和选民选区之外的投票。 2023年，进行了60万次此类投票，占总数的21%。这些选票往往有利于左翼——2023 年，特别投票结果是 Te Pāti Māori（毛利党）和绿党赢得了三个席位。
周六晚上，近 100% 的常规选票已清点完毕，国家党获得了 42 个席位，第 13 号法案和新西兰优先党获得了 12 个席位。加起来，67 个席位的多数席位微乎其微，左翼集团仅落后 3 个席位。
午夜前，卢克森在奥克兰高架桥活动中心对一屋子的党内忠实人士发表讲话，他表示，结果“势均力敌”，在谈判开始之前需要清点特别选票。
他说，国家党仍然是议会中最大的政党，并且有“组建下一届政府的途径”。国家党在党内投票中领先工党 0.02%。
克里斯·希普金斯 (Chris Hipkins) 领导的工党获得 35 个席位，而其传统联盟伙伴绿党 (Greens) 赢得 16 个席位，毛利党 (Te Pāti Māori) 赢得 5 个席位。即使中间派新人机遇党拥有七个席位，左翼集团距离组建政府还差三个席位。
在惠灵顿北部上哈特的大都会俱乐部，在一群喧闹的支持者面前，希普金斯开玩笑说新西兰已经发声了，但“可能需要更长的时间才能弄清楚他们所说的内容”。
希普金斯说：“从今晚的情况来看，很明显，我们在一段时间内不会知道下一届政府的形式。”他承诺，如果最终计票结果对工党有利，工党将“直接开始工作”。
在经济低迷和通货膨胀居高不下的情况下，两个主要政党的垮台，为包括行动党、新西兰优先党和绿党在内的较小政党提供了创纪录的支持率。它还帮助机遇号首次进入议会。
选举前的民意调查显示，机遇号有望成为造王者。在现阶段，右翼集团不需要政党来执政，但如果特别投票改变格局，其预期的作用可能会实现。
目前，中间派政党的得票率为5.9%，已经达到了进入议会所需的门槛，这是历史性的首次。自1996年新西兰采用混合议员比例（MMP）选举制度以来，没有任何新政党能够达到这一门槛——所有其他小政党都是由国会议员或从大政党中分裂出来的团体诞生的。
该党领袖 Qiulae Wong 告诉奥克兰的支持者，她感到“兴奋”。
“这对我们来说看起来非常有希望，”她说。 “让我们看看其余的选票如何下降。”
新西兰选举即将迎来悬念，小党将成为造王者
在新西兰，选民投两票：一张投给选区议员，另一张投给政党。该制度旨在产生一个反映各党派在全国投票中所占份额的议会。
然而，如果新西兰人投票选出的某个政党的议员人数多于其政党投票所赋予的议员人数，他们就可以将多余的议员保留在所谓的“悬而未决”的地方。

title_en: Israel's president tasks opposition leader Eisenkot with forming government
title_zh: 以色列总统责成反对党领袖艾森科特组建政府
summary: Neither PM Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc nor that of his rival secured a majority in last week's election.
summary_zh: 总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的集团和他的竞争对手的集团都没有在上周的选举中获得多数席位。
body_en: Israel president asks opposition leader Eisenkot to form government - BBC News
Israel's president says he will task opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot with forming a new coalition government.

Isaac Herzog has been holding talks with political parties after neither Eisenkot's bloc nor that of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu secured a majority in Israel's parliament, known as the Knesset, following last week's election.
Eisenkot will now have 28 days to try to form a new administration, with a potential 14-day extension.
"Now is the time to form a national emergency government. I will do everything to ensure we are worthy," the former military chief wrote on X.
No political party in Israel has ever won an outright majority, meaning all governments have been coalitions.

Netanyahu's right-wing Likud party and its far-right and ultra-Orthodox Jewish allies won 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset, while Eisenkot's centrist Yashar party and three other Jewish opposition parties in his bloc won 48.
Two Arab-led alliances, the United Arab List and the Joint List, together won an unprecedented 19 seats following a surge in turnout among Arab voters.
That positions them as potential kingmakers. However, all but one of the Jewish parties pledged before the polls not to work with them to form a government.
Herzog said that, after consulting all parties during the week, he would give Eisenkot the first chance to form a government.
A statement from the president's office said he had informed both Eisenkot and Netanyahu of the decision.
Following consultations with delegations from the incoming Knesset members, Eisenkot received 67 recommendations for the premiership and Netanyahu 46, the statement said.
The president has broad discretion to pick someone they believe has the best chance of building a coalition and does not have to choose the leader of the party with the most seats.

The election results had implied three possible options for the formation of a government : a national unity administration involving both Netanyahu and Eisenkot, a right-wing coalition involving Netanyahu and defectors from Eisenkot's bloc, or an Eisenkot-led government supported by the Arab parties.
Eisenkot and every member of his bloc bar one has previously refused to enter government with Arab parties, but there has been speculation that an agreement could be reached.
He could also attempt to reach a deal with ultra-Orthodox parties, but that too would be difficult.

There is precedent for a unity government. In 2020, following three deadlocked elections, Netanyahu and his centrist rival Benny Gantz agreed a power-sharing deal in which the leadership rotated between the two.

During his consultations with the parties, Herzog had said that to prevent another round of elections and to build a stable government, he expected "factions and their representatives to understand that, in the current reality, not every commitment and promise can be fulfilled".
In the period 2019 to 2022, one of the most politically fractured in Israeli politics, there were five separate elections as Netanyahu and his rivals struggled time and again to co-operate.
Israel's president begins consultations with parties after election deadlock
body_zh: 以色列总统要求反对党领袖艾森科特组建政府 - BBC 新闻
以色列总统表示，他将责成反对党领袖加迪·艾森科特组建新的联合政府。
在上周的选举后，艾森科特的集团和总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的集团都未能在以色列议会（即以色列议会）中获得多数席位，艾萨克·赫尔佐格一直在与各政党进行会谈。
艾森科特现在有 28 天的时间尝试组建新政府，并可能延长 14 天。
“现在是组建国家紧急政府的时候了。我将尽一切努力确保我们值得，”艾森科特在 X 上写道，这是他对任命宣布的第一反应。
以色列没有一个政党赢得过绝对多数，这意味着所有政府都是联合政府。
内塔尼亚胡的右翼利库德集团及其极右翼和极端正统犹太盟友在议会120个席位中赢得了53个席位，而艾森科特的中间派亚沙尔党和他所在集团的其他三个犹太反对党赢得了48个席位。
随着阿拉伯选民投票率的激增，两个阿拉伯领导的联盟——阿拉伯联合名单和联合名单——史无前例地共同赢得了 19 个席位。
这使他们成为潜在的拥王者。然而，除了一个犹太政党外，所有犹太政党在投票前都承诺不会与他们合作组建政府。
赫尔佐格表示，在本周与各方协商后，他将给予艾森科特第一次组建政府的机会。
总统办公室的一份声明称，他已将这一决定告知艾森科特和内塔尼亚胡。
声明称，在与即将上任的议会议员代表团进行磋商后，艾森科特收到了 67 项总理职位建议，内塔尼亚胡收到了 46 项建议。
总统拥有广泛的自由裁量权，可以选择他们认为最有可能建立联盟的人，而不必选择拥有最多席位的政党的领导人。
选举结果暗示了组建政府的三种可能选择：内塔尼亚胡和艾森科特共同参与的民族团结政府，内塔尼亚胡和艾森科特集团叛逃者组成的右翼联盟，或由阿拉伯政党支持的艾森科特领导的政府。
艾森科特和他的集团中除一名成员外的每一位成员此前都拒绝与阿拉伯政党一起进入政府，但有人猜测可能会达成协议。
他还可以尝试与极端正统派政党达成协议，但这也很困难。
联合政府是有先例的。 2020年，在三场陷入僵局的选举之后，内塔尼亚胡和他的中间派竞争对手本尼·甘茨达成了一项权力分享协议，领导层由两人轮流担任。
赫尔佐格在与各党派磋商时表示，为了防止另一轮选举并建立一个稳定的政府，他希望“各派别及其代表明白，在当前现实中，并非所有承诺和诺言都能兑现”。
2019年至2022年是以色列政治最分裂的时期之一，内塔尼亚胡和他的对手一次又一次地努力合作，期间举行了五次单独的选举。

title_en: Ukraine: Russia hits Kyiv with airstrikes ahead of trilateral talks
title_zh: 乌克兰：三边会谈前俄罗斯空袭基辅
summary: The strikes hit a major bridge and energy facilities in the Kyiv region. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy accused Moscow of trying to "push" Ukraine "into a blackout" ahead of talks in Abu Dhabi.
summary_zh: 袭击袭击了基辅地区的一座主要桥梁和能源设施。总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基指责莫斯科试图“推动”乌克兰“
body_en: Russia launched strikes on Kyiv and surrounding areas overnight, Russian and Ukrainian authorities said on Saturday.
Russia's Defense Ministry said the strikes hit the Northern Bridge and the Meridian Plant.
Moscow said that the bridge was being used by the Ukrainian military to transport weapons and military equipment, while the plant is used to produce Flamingo cruise missiles.
It said the strikes damaged several energy and industrial facilities in the Kyiv region, as well as an electricity substation in the neighboring Zhytomyr region and a cargo vessel in the Black Sea.
What have Ukrainian authorities said about the attacks?

Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko confirmed the strikes on the Northern Bridge, adding that the Ukrainian capital found itself in an "extremely difficult" situation regarding power, heating and water supplies. Overnight temperatures dropped to 0 degrees Celsius (32 degrees Fahrenheit) in the city.
The Kyiv region's governor, Tymur Tkachenko, said energy facilities in three of its districts had been hit.
Ukrainian authorities said that one person was killed and eight were wounded in the overnight attack.
In a statement on social media , president Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that Russia used 172 drones and 36 ballistic missiles during the attack.
He said that Russia was trying to "push Kyiv … and the entire country into a blackout" and repeated his call for increased support from the United States .
Russia has stepped up airstrikes on Ukraine in recent months, targeting energy infrastructure and major cities, and more recently hitting bridges.

The strikes come days before a fourth round of trilateral talks between Kyiv, Moscow and Washington in Abu Dhabi in the United Arab Emirates.
Previous rounds of US-brokered talks have failed to achieve any breakthroughs, with territorial and security questions remaining major points of contention.
On Friday, US President Donald Trump said the war could be close to being settled and that he envisioned a "big, beautiful agreement" with Moscow that involves "all of Europe."
Last Friday, a six-day local ceasefire in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky in the southern Kherson region enabled the evacuation of some 800 residents.
The brief truce was brokered by US First Lady Melania Trump.

body_zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰当局周六表示，俄罗斯连夜对基辅及周边地区发动了袭击。
俄罗斯国防部表示，袭击袭击了北桥和子午线工厂。
莫斯科表示，乌克兰军方使用这座桥运输武器和军事装备，而该工厂则用于生产火烈鸟巡航导弹。
据称，袭击损坏了基辅地区的多个能源和工业设施，以及邻近日托米尔地区的一座变电站和黑海的一艘货船。
乌克兰当局对袭击事件有何评论？
基辅市长维塔利·克里琴科证实了北桥遭到袭击的消息，并补充说，乌克兰首都在电力、供暖和供水方面处于“极其困难”的境地。该市夜间气温降至 0 摄氏度（32 华氏度）。
基辅地区州长泰穆尔·特卡琴科表示，该地区三个地区的能源设施遭到袭击。
乌克兰当局表示，夜间袭击造成 1 人死亡、8 人受伤。
总统泽连斯基在社交媒体上发表声明称，俄罗斯在袭击中动用了 172 架无人机和 36 枚弹道导弹。
他表示，俄罗斯正试图“让基辅……以及整个国家陷入停电”，并再次呼吁美国加大支持力度。
近几个月来，俄罗斯加强了对乌克兰的空袭，目标是能源基础设施和主要城市，最近还袭击了桥梁。

美国斡旋的前几轮会谈未能取得任何突破，领土和安全问题仍然是主要争论点。

title_en: Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia faces threat as Russian drones close in

summary_zh: 乌克兰的扎波罗热曾经是逃离战争的人们的避难所，现在面临着越来越大的危险。
body_en: Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia faces threat as Russian drones close in | Russia-Ukraine war | Al Jazeera

title_en: US offers $20m reward for information about Iran's nuclear programme
title_zh: 美国悬赏2000万美元征集有关伊朗核计划的信息
summary: Donald Trump has repeatedly raised the prospecting of renewing strikes against Iran's nuclear facilities.
summary_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普多次提出重新打击伊朗核设施的可能性。
body_en: The US has announced a reward of up to $20 million for information about Iran's nuclear programme.
The State Department's Rewards for Justice is also offering to potentially relocate the person who provides such details.
President Donald Trump claimed last year that Iran's nuclear facilities had been "completely and totally obliterated " following a bombing campaign by the US and Israel.
Iran insists its nuclear programme is peaceful and that it has no intention of developing a nuclear weapon.
Meanwhile, the US military says it is setting up a task force to enhance Washington's efforts to restrict Iran's movement of weapons and sanctioned material across its borders.
The US military's Central Command (Centcom) said Task Force Iron Gate would operate from Tampa, Florida, and would work with other US government agencies.
As well as the movement of weapons, it will also focus on dual-use and illegal revenue streams.
Centcom estimates that its naval blockade of Iran's ports has prevented the country from exporting more than $25bn in crude oil.
Major construction ongoing near Iran missile bases, satellite images suggest

A US State Department statement about its multi-million dollar reward said it was offering the money for information about the Iranian programme, including "facilities, equipment and associated personnel".

It said Iran's "lack of compliance with the IAEA [the International Atomic Energy Agency] on safeguards obligations has led to the agency's loss of 'continuity of knowledge' regarding Iran's production and inventory of key components like [nuclear] centrifuges".
Centrifuges are needed to produce enriched uranium, which can be used to make reactor fuel for civilian use but also for nuclear weapons if enriched to around 90% purity or higher.

There had been mounting speculation that the US might resume significant strikes in Iran after the midterm elections, though Trump told reporters, prior to the polls, that he was in "no rush" to do so.
In an interview with Fox News on the eve of the midterms, the president also said the US "might need to go after Pickaxe [Mountain]", an underground site linked to Iran's nuclear programme.
This was "not a big deal" and could be done in "one hour", Trump said.
The president has repeatedly threatened to bomb the suspected underground site on previous occasions.

However, both Trump and Vice-President JD Vance have said public opposition to the war on Iran fuelled heavy losses for their Republican Party in this week's midterm elections, which has led to speculation the White House may no longer seek an escalation in the conflict.
On Friday, Trump insisted that Iran was keen to end the eight-month conflict with the US, stressing the damage to Tehran's economy and military.
"We're dealing with them now. They want to make a deal very badly," he said.
Qatar's foreign ministry spokesman said on Tuesday that both sides were "reviewing the ideas and proposals we have presented" and that it remained hopeful of a deal being agreed.
body_zh: 美国宣布悬赏高达 2000 万美元，征集有关伊朗核计划的信息。
国务院正义奖励计划还提出可能重新安置提供此类详细信息的人。
唐纳德·特朗普总统去年声称，在美国和以色列的轰炸行动之后，伊朗的核设施已被“彻底摧毁”。
伊朗坚称其核计划是和平目的，无意发展核武器。
与此同时，美国军方表示正在成立一个特别工作组，以加强华盛顿限制伊朗武器和受制裁材料跨境流动的努力。
美国军方中央司令部（Centcom）表示，铁门特遣部队将从佛罗里达州坦帕市开展行动，并将与其他美国政府机构合作。
除了武器的流动外，它还将重点关注军民两用和非法收入来源。
Centcom 估计，其对伊朗港口的海上封锁导致该国无法出口超过 250 亿美元的原油。
卫星图像显示，伊朗导弹基地附近正在进行重大建设
美国国务院关于其数百万美元奖励的声明称，它提供资金以获取有关伊朗计划的信息，包括“设施、设备和相关人员”。
报告称，伊朗“不遵守国际原子能机构的保障义务，导致该机构失去了有关伊朗生产和库存等关键部件（如核）离心机的‘连续性知识’”。
生产浓缩铀需要离心机，浓缩铀可用于制造民用反应堆燃料，如果浓缩至 90% 左右或更高，还可用于制造核武器。
人们越来越多地猜测美国可能会在中期选举后恢复对伊朗的大规模打击，尽管特朗普在民意调查前告诉记者，他“不急于”这样做。
在中期选举前夕接受福克斯新闻采访时，总统还表示，美国“可能需要追查镐[山]”，这是一个与伊朗核计划有关的地下场所。
特朗普表示，这“没什么大不了的”，可以在“一小时内”完成。
总统此前曾多次威胁要轰炸这个可疑的地下场所。
然而，特朗普和副总统万斯均表示，公众对伊朗战争的反对导致共和党在本周的中期选举中遭受惨重损失，这引发人们猜测白宫可能不再寻求冲突升级。
周五，特朗普坚称伊朗渴望结束与美国长达八个月的冲突，并强调这对德黑兰经济和军事造成的损害。
“我们现在正在与他们打交道。他们非常想达成协议，”他说。
卡塔尔外交部发言人周二表示，双方正在“审查我们提出的想法和建议”，并且仍然对达成协议抱有希望。

title_en: Houthis say at least 25 killed in Saudi air strike
title_zh: 胡塞武装称沙特空袭造成至少25人死亡
summary: Saudi Arabia, which leads a coalition fighting the Houthis in Yemen, has not commented.
summary_zh: 领导在也门打击胡塞武装的联盟的沙特阿拉伯尚未发表评论。
body_en: Media linked to the Houthi movement in Yemen say that at least 25 people, including women and children, have been killed in airstrikes by Saudi Arabia.
There has been no comment from the Saudi-led coalition backing the internationally recognised government in Yemen.

Live video footage on Al Masirah - a television station run by the Houthis - has shown rescuers pulling bodies out of the rubble of several buildings in al-Shariyah, a town to the east of the capital, Sanaa.
The bodies of young children can be seen among those dug out from the ruins.
The television station has also shown a number of injured people being carried on stretchers to hospital.
Saba news agency, which is also run by the Houthis, said the attack was carried out by Saudi Arabia.
The Saudis have led a coalition that has been fighting the Houthis for more than a decade in support of Yemen's internationally recognised government.
The war in Yemen had been dormant for several years but reignited as a result of the Iran war.
A truce began to fall apart when Saudi Arabia struck the airport in Sanaa - which is controlled by the Houthis - to prevent an Iranian plan landing there.

The Tehran-backed Houthis subsequently targeted Abha airport in Saudi Arabia, then began hitting Saudi ships that have been using the Red Sea off the coast of Yemen as an alternative oil export route to the Strait of Hormuz.
Major fighting has since resumed in Yemen between the Houthis and forces fighting for the Saudi-backed government of Yemen.
On Friday, an attack on a market in Taiz province, which has been the focus of much of the recent fighting, is reported to have killed 30 people.
The Houthis accused the Saudis of carrying out the strike, while government forces accused the Houthis of having fired a missile at the site.
The United Nations says more than 1,600 people have been killed and more than 300,000 displaced since fighting resumed.
The Saudis have regularly bombed Houthi positions, while the group has fired multiple missiles at targets inside Saudi Arabia, including airports and oil facilities.
Hours before the strike that hit al-Shariyah, the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a missile heading towards Riyadh.
A Houthi leader, Mahdi al-Mashat, has vowed that the group will take revenge for the latest attacks in Yemen.
body_zh: 与也门胡塞运动有关的媒体称，至少 25 人在沙特阿拉伯的空袭中丧生，其中包括妇女和儿童。
支持国际公认的也门政府的沙特领导的联盟尚未发表评论。
胡塞武装运营的电视台 Al Masirah 的现场视频显示，救援人员从首都萨那东部城镇 al-Shariyah 的几栋建筑废墟中拉出尸体。
从废墟中挖出的尸体中可以看到幼儿的尸体。
电视台还播放了一些伤者被担架抬往医院的画面。
同样由胡塞武装管理的萨巴通讯社称，此次袭击是沙特阿拉伯所为。
沙特领导的联盟十多年来一直与胡塞武装作战，以支持国际公认的也门政府。
也门战争已沉寂数年，但因伊朗战争而重新燃起。
当沙特阿拉伯袭击胡塞武装控制的萨那机场以阻止伊朗计划降落时，休战协议开始破裂。
德黑兰支持的胡塞武装随后袭击了沙特阿拉伯的艾卜哈机场，然后开始袭击沙特船只，这些船只一直在也门海岸附近的红海作为通往霍尔木兹海峡的替代石油出口路线。
此后，也门胡塞武装和沙特支持的也门政府的武装力量之间又重新爆发了大规模战斗。
周五，塔伊兹省的一个市场遭到袭击，据报道，该袭击已造成 30 人死亡，该袭击一直是近期战斗的焦点。
胡塞武装指责沙特发动了这次袭击，而政府军则指责胡塞武装向该地点发射了导弹。
联合国表示，自战斗重新爆发以来，已有超过 1,600 人丧生，超过 30 万人流离失所。
沙特经常轰炸胡塞武装阵地，该组织还向沙特阿拉伯境内的目标发射多枚导弹，包括机场和石油设施。
在袭击 al-Shariyah 的袭击发生前几个小时，沙特领导的联军表示拦截了一枚飞向利雅得的导弹。
胡塞武装领导人迈赫迪·马沙特誓言，该组织将为也门最近发生的袭击事件进行报复。

title_en: No clear winner after tight New Zealand general election
title_zh: 激烈的新西兰大选后没有明显的赢家
summary: Weeks of coalition talks could follow after preliminary results pointed to a highly divided national parliament.
summary_zh: 初步结果表明国民议会存在严重分歧，随后可能会举行数周的联合谈判。
body_en: By Olivia Ireland and Tiffanie Turnbull , Reporting from Wellington
There was no clear winner following New Zealand's election on Saturday, as the leaders of its two major parties preparing for negotiations to form a coalition government.

Prime Minister Christopher Luxon's centre-right National Party won 42 seats but was 19 short of the simple majority needed to form a government, despite being the largest party, preliminary results show.
Combined with their coalition partners ACT and New Zealand First, they would have a slim lead over the left-leaning bloc if a deal could be reached.
But opposition leader Chris Hipkins, whose Labour Party won 36 seats, showed no signs of conceding, saying the "shape of the next government" will remain uncertain "for a while".
The tight result followed a campaign shaped by the cost of living and unemployment.

Projections show the National Party on 42 seats and Labour on 36. The Greens are on 16, with ACT on 13, New Zealand First on 12, the Opportunity Party on 7 and Te Pāti Māori, which represents Māori interests, on 5.
The electoral commission was not due to announce the official result until 27 November.
Luxon congratulated Hipkins on a "very hard-fought race" before addressing party colleagues, saying "whatever the final count, we are incredibly proud of each and everyone for you".
He said he would run a caretaker government until the final results were confirmed later in the month, adding: "With those final results there can then be meaningful negotiations."
Elsewhere, Labour leader Hipkins said "the people have spoken", adding: "It may take a bit longer to work out what they've said."
Hipkins said the results made clear the "next parliament is going to require all of us to compromise, to work together and to find a common ground".
More than 99% of votes have been counted in New Zealand, with National and Labour neck-and-neck in terms of vote share.
But the preliminary results pointed to historically low support for the two major parties, with a combined vote share of around 60%.
They were followed by the Greens, ACT, New Zealand First, centrist party Opportunity and Te Pāti Māori, which represents Māori interests.
New Zealand election 2026: What you need to know
The Opportunity Party crossed the 5% threshold to enter parliament for the first time, with leader Qiulae Wong saying would work with either side.
It has been described as this election's kingmaker as it remains open to working with either major bloc, but its leaders said they would negotiate first with the party that secures the most seats.
Speaking at Opportunity's watch party, Wong told supporters: "We believe that we can change the way we do politics to focus on the future, on the next generation, and on finding common ground."
Professor Andrew Geddis from the University of Otago, an expert in election law, said "the Opportunity Party as a wildcard player" could "determine which bloc of parties is able to govern".
body_zh: 奥利维亚·爱尔兰和蒂芙妮·特恩布尔报道，惠灵顿报道
新西兰周六大选后没有明显的赢家，因为该国两个主要政党的领导人正准备进行谈判以组建联合政府。
初步结果显示，总理克里斯托弗·卢克森(Christopher Luxon)领导的中右翼国家党赢得了42个席位，但尽管是最大政党，但距离组建政府所需的简单多数还差19个。
加上他们的联盟伙伴行动党和新西兰优先党，如果能够达成协议，他们将以微弱优势领先于左倾集团。
但工党赢得 36 个席位的反对党领袖克里斯·希普金斯 (Chris Hipkins) 没有表现出让步的迹象，他表示，“下一届政府的形式”将在“一段时间内”仍不确定。
在一场由生活成本和失业因素影响的竞选活动之后，结果出现了紧缩。
预测显示，国家党获得 42 个席位，工党获得 36 个席位。绿党获得 16 个席位，行动党获得 13 个席位，新西兰优先党获得 12 个席位，机会党获得 7 个席位，代表毛利人利益的毛利党获得 5 个席位。
选举委员会要到 11 月 27 日才会宣布正式结果。
卢克森祝贺希普金斯参加了一场“非常艰苦的竞选”，然后向党内同事发表讲话，并表示“无论最终结果如何，我们都为你的每一个人感到无比自豪”。
他表示，他将管理一个看守政府，直到本月晚些时候最终结果得到确认，并补充道：“有了这些最终结果，就可以进行有意义的谈判。”
在其他地方，工党领袖希普金斯表示“人们已经发声了”，并补充道：“可能需要更长的时间才能弄清楚他们所说的内容。”
希普金斯表示，结果清楚地表明“下一届议会将要求我们所有人妥协、共同努力并找到共同点”。
新西兰99%以上的选票已经清点完毕，国家党和工党的得票率不相上下。
但初步结果显示，两大党的支持率处于历史低位，合计得票率约为 60%。
其次是绿党、行动党、新西兰优先党、中间派机会党和代表毛利人利益的毛利党。

它被描述为这次选举的王者制造者，因为它仍然愿意与任何一个主要集团合作，但其领导人表示，他们将首先与获得最多席位的政党进行谈判。
在机遇号的观看聚会上，黄对支持者说：“我们相信我们可以改变我们从事政治的方式，以关注未来、下一代并寻找共同点。”

title_en: ANC faces bruising defeat in South African local elections with 80% of ballots counted
title_zh: 南非地方选举80%选票已清点 非国大面临惨败
summary: Former liberation movement’s share of national vote almost 14 percentage points below 2021 result The African National Congress is on course to suffer a bruising defeat in South Africa’s local elections, with the once dominant party of Nelson Mandela falling t
summary_zh: 前解放运动在全国选票中所占比例比 2021 年结果低近 14 个百分点
body_en: ANC faces bruising defeat in South African local elections with 80% of ballots counted | ANC (African National Congress)
Former liberation movement’s share of national vote almost 14 percentage points below 2021 result

The African National Congress is on course to suffer a bruising defeat in South Africa’s local elections, with the once dominant party of Nelson Mandela falling to under a third of the vote nationally with more than 80% of ballots counted.

Wednesday’s fragmented vote marks another stage in the decline of the ANC, which has led national governments since the end of white minority apartheid rule in 1994. High unemployment, crime, corruption and poor local service delivery have all contributed to voters turning away from the party .

The former liberation movement is projected to lose its status as the biggest party in the two most populous provinces, Gauteng and KwaZulu-Natal, as parties began coalition negotiations behind closed doors. The final results are expected to be announced on Sunday.

The ANC was on 31.8% of the vote nationally, almost 14 percentage points below its 2021 local election result. The centre-right, white-led Democratic Alliance (DA) had 24.1% of the vote, while the uMkhonto weSizwe (MK) party of the former ANC president Jacob Zuma was on 9.3%.
Turnout also rose in Wednesday’s poll. The election commission estimated that 54.5% of registered voters cast their ballot, up from 46% five years ago.

The final shape of coalitions in some of the country’s biggest cities remained unclear with the final votes still being counted. Senior figures in key parties said they would talk with almost anyone, while keeping negotiating strategies under wraps.

In Johannesburg, South Africa’s commercial capital and biggest city, with 4.8 million people, voters have had to contend with regular water and power cuts , uncollected rubbish and potholes. The municipality, which has seen 10 changes of mayor in the last decade amid unstable coalitions, has admitted to a 220bn rand (£9.9bn) infrastructure spending backlog.

With just over half of votes counted in Johannesburg, the DA was leading with 40%, having run an energetic campaign under Helen Zille, a 75-year-old former Cape Town mayor. The ANC, which leads the current coalition, was in second place on 17.5%. ActionSA, a rightwing party led by Herman Mashaba, was on 15.5%. Mashaba has pledged never to work with Zille, whom he calls “racist”, something she vehemently denies.

Many of the ANC’s township strongholds have yet to report full results. The Council for Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), a respected thinktank, has projected the DA will finish with 34%, the ANC 20% and ActionSA 16.8%.
Coalitions in Gauteng’s three city municipalities are often negotiated together. The DA is leading in all three.

The MK party, led by 84-year-old Zuma as he continues to weather and deny numerous corruption allegations, is expected to displace the ANC as the largest party in KwaZulu-Natal. Founded in 2023, it mixes socially conservative Zulu nationalism with pledges to redistribute land and wealth from white to black South Africans.

With half of votes counted in eThekwini municipality, which contains Durban, the MK had 41%, meaning other parties could form a coalition to keep it out of power. Meanwhile, the DA is projected to maintain its majority in Cape Town, despite growing middle-class anger over rising housing costs .
Voters choose a local councillor and a party, with seats allocated via proportional representation. Councillors will then have two weeks to elect mayors and form municipal governments.
body_zh: 非洲人国民大会在南非地方选举中遭遇惨败，80%的选票已清点ANC（非洲人国民大会）
前解放运动在全国选票中所占比例比 2021 年结果低近 14 个百分点
非洲人国民大会在南非地方选举中势必遭遇惨败，纳尔逊·曼德拉(Nelson Mandela)领导的一度占主导地位的政党在全国选票已计入超过80%的情况下，其得票率跌至三分之一以下。
周三零散的投票标志着非国大衰落的又一个阶段。自1994年白人少数种族隔离统治结束以来，非国大一直领导着各国政府。高失业率、犯罪、腐败和糟糕的当地服务交付都导致选民远离该党。
随着各党派开始闭门进行联合谈判，前解放运动预计将失去豪登省和夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省这两个人口最多省份最大政党的地位。最终结果预计将于周日公布。
非国大在全国的选票率为 31.8%，比 2021 年地方选举的结果低近 14 个百分点。白人领导的中右翼民主联盟 (DA) 获得 24.1% 的选票，而前非国大主席雅各布·祖马 (Jacob Zuma) 领导的 uMkhonto weSizwe (MK) 政党则获得 9.3% 的选票。
周三的民意调查的投票率也有所上升。选举委员会估计，54.5% 的登记选民参加了投票，高于五年前的 46%。
该国一些最大城市的联盟的最终形态仍不清楚，最终选票仍在统计中。主要政党的高级人士表示，他们几乎会与任何人交谈，同时对谈判策略保密。
在拥有 480 万人口的南非商业首都和最大城市约翰内斯堡，选民不得不面对经常断水断电、垃圾无人收集和坑坑洼洼的问题。在过去十年中，由于联盟不稳定，该市已经更换了 10 次市长，并承认有 2200 亿兰特（99 亿英镑）的基础设施支出积压。

约翰内斯堡的选票已清点一半多一点，地方检察官在 75 岁的开普敦前市长海伦·齐勒 (Helen Zille) 的领导下开展了一场充满活力的竞选活动，以 40% 的得票率领先。领导当前联盟的非国大以 17.5% 的支持率位居第二。由赫尔曼·马沙巴 (Herman Mashaba) 领导的右翼政党 ActionSA 的支持率为 15.5%。马沙巴承诺永远不会与齐勒合作，他称齐勒为“种族主义者”，但她强烈否认这一点。
非国大的许多乡镇据点尚未报告完整结果。受人尊敬的智囊团科学与工业研究委员会 (CSIR) 预计 DA 将获得 34%、ANC 20% 和 ActionSA 16.8%。
豪登省三个城市的联盟经常一起谈判。 DA 在这三个方面都处于领先地位。
由 84 岁的祖马领导的 MK 党继续经受住并否认众多腐败指控，预计将取代非国大成为夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省最大政党。它成立于 2023 年，将社会保守的祖鲁民族主义与将土地和财富从南非白人重新分配给黑人的承诺结合在一起。
德班所在的 eThekwini 市已计票一半，MK 获得 41% 的选票，这意味着其他政党可以组成联盟来阻止其掌权。与此同时，尽管中产阶级对不断上涨的住房成本越来越愤怒，但预计DA仍将在开普敦保持多数席位。
选民选出一名地方议员和一个政党，席位通过比例代表制分配。然后，议员们将有两周时间选举市长并组建市政府。

title_en: Meghan's father Thomas Markle under house arrest after child sex abuse material charge
title_zh: 梅根的父亲托马斯·马克尔因儿童性虐待材料指控而被软禁
summary: The 82-year-old appeared in court in Florida after the FBI searched two Los Angeles-area storage units he rented.
summary_zh: 联邦调查局搜查了这位 82 岁的老人在洛杉矶地区租用的两个储藏室后，他出现在佛罗里达州的法庭上。
body_en: Thomas Markle, the father of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, has been placed under house detention at his assisted living facility in Florida after being charged over possession of child sex abuse material.
Markle, 82, was arrested in Florida on a federal complaint alleging he held images that show child sex abuse, the US Department of Justice (DoJ) said.
He is charged with one count of possessing indecent images of children, the DoJ said. Markle has previously denied allegations of possessing images of child sex abuse, calling them "sick lies".
In a 30-minute court hearing on Friday he was also ordered to submit to electronic monitoring, but no plea was taken.
At the court hearing, the charges were laid out against him by federal prosecutor Courtenay Derry, according to the BBC's US partner CBS News.
He was brought into court in a wheelchair, escorted by two US Marshals. Markle was wearing black trousers and a black t-shirt.
No plea was taken during the hearing, and an arraignment date in California will be determined in due course, a joint statement from the DoJ and the US Attorney's Office Central California said.
The Duke and Duchess of Sussex have not commented on Markle's arrest.

Markle was arrested after the FBI, acting on warrants, searched storage units in LA registered to him which he had rented since 2008, with the last payment being made in October this year, the DoJ said.
Inside the units the FBI says agents seized about 78 items, including film negatives, slides and books that they allege contained child sex abuse material.
FBI director Kash Patel said authorities "moved quickly" when arresting Markle.
"Mr Markle allegedly targeted innocent children and sought to steal their innocence through his criminal actions," Patel said.

He added that the FBI would "use every single resource at our disposal to protect innocent kids – any predator who targets children will have zero safe haven in this country or anywhere they try to hide".
Witnesses "positively identified" Markle in two of the images believed to contain child sex abuse material.
In those images, the man pictured "appears to be in the age range of 30s to 40s", which suggests the alleged abuse dates back decades as Markle is currently 82 years old.
Last month, police in the Philippines obtained a warrant to examine devices allegedly removed from Markle's former home in the country.
Four boxes of material, including computers, phones, hard drives and old video tapes, were handed to officers by Meghan's half brother Thomas Markle Jr.

Markle Sr moved to the Philippines last year after he had a series of strokes, and lived in Cebu until May. He was then reportedly living in a Florida rehabilitation centre learning to walk again after having his leg amputated.
In October, London's Metropolitan Police confirmed that it had received a letter in 2019 making a "number of claims" relating to Markle Sr.

The Met said information contained in the letter, which related to allegations against Meghan's father outside the UK, was passed on to the office of the Duke and Duchess of Sussex, but it did not share it with other law enforcement agencies.
body_zh: 苏塞克斯公爵夫人梅根的父亲托马斯·马克尔在被指控持有儿童性虐待材料后，被软禁在佛罗里达州的辅助生活设施中。
美国司法部 (DoJ) 表示，82 岁的马克尔因联邦投诉在佛罗里达州被捕，指控他持有显示儿童性虐待的图片。
美国司法部表示，他被指控一项拥有儿童不雅图像的罪名。马克尔此前否认拥有儿童性虐待图片的指控，称其为“病态的谎言”。
在周五 30 分钟的法庭听证会上，他还被命令接受电子监控，但没有提出抗辩。
据英国广播公司美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻报道，在法庭听证会上，联邦检察官考特尼·德里对他提出了指控。
他在两名美国法警的陪同下坐在轮椅上被带到法庭。马克尔穿着黑色裤子和黑色T恤。
美国司法部和加州中部检察官办公室的联合声明称，听证会期间没有提出任何抗辩，加州的提审日期将在适当的时候确定。
苏塞克斯公爵和公爵夫人尚未对马克尔被捕发表评论。
美国司法部表示，联邦调查局根据搜查令搜查了马克尔在洛杉矶登记的存储单元，马克尔自 2008 年以来一直租用，最后一次付款是在今年 10 月，随后马克尔被捕。
FBI 表示，探员在这些单位内查获了约 78 件物品，其中包括他们声称含有儿童性虐待材料的电影底片、幻灯片和书籍。
联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔表示，当局在逮捕马克尔时“行动迅速”。
帕特尔说：“据称，马克尔先生以无辜儿童为目标，并试图通过他的犯罪行为窃取他们的清白。”
他补充说，联邦调查局将“利用我们掌握的一切资源来保护无辜的孩子——任何以儿童为目标的掠夺者在这个国家或他们试图隐藏的任何地方都将拥有零的避难所”。
目击者在其中两张据信包含儿童性虐待内容的照片中“肯定地识别出了”马克尔。
在这些照片中，照片中的男子“年龄似乎在 30 岁到 40 岁之间”，这表明涉嫌的虐待行为可以追溯到几十年前，而马克尔目前已经 82 岁了。
上个月，菲律宾警方获得搜查令，对据称从马克尔在该国的故居中移走的设备进行检查。
梅根同父异母的弟弟小托马斯·马克尔将四箱材料交给了警方，其中包括电脑、手机、硬盘和旧录像带。
老马克尔去年在经历了一系列中风后搬到了菲律宾，并在宿雾住到了五月。据报道，他的腿被截肢后，当时住在佛罗里达州的康复中心，学习再次行走。
10 月，伦敦大都会警察局证实，他们在 2019 年收到了一封信，提出了与老马克尔有关的“多项指控”。
大都会表示，这封信中包含的信息涉及对英国境外梅根父亲的指控，已转交给苏塞克斯公爵和公爵夫人的办公室，但没有与其他执法机构分享。

body_en: Israel’s president picks Eisenkot over Netanyahu to form next government | Israel Election 2026 News | Al Jazeera
Share Israel’s president picks Eisenkot over Netanyahu to form next government on social media
Israel’s President Isaac Herzog has tasked Gadi Eisenkot with forming the country’s next government, passing over the former army chief’s rival, Benjamin Netanyahu.
Herzog told Eisenkot of his decision on Saturday evening and will formally hand him the mandate at a ceremony on Sunday, the president’s spokesperson said.

list 2 of 3 Palestinian citizens of Israel put to ‘loyalty test’ after election wins
list 3 of 3 President Herzog faces key choice as Israel struggles to form government
Herzog held consultations with political parties this week to decide who he would appoint to form a government after neither side secured a majority in the October 27 general election.
Some 67 lawmakers, including from Arab-led parties, endorsed Eisenkot, leader of the Yashar party, to form the next government, while only 46 backed Netanyahu, the current prime minister.
Eisenkot will have 28 days – with a possible 14-day extension – to build a coalition of at least 61 of the Knesset’s 120 seats, the minimum threshold for a government.

In the October election, Eisenkot’s four-party alliance won 48 seats, while Netanyahu’s right-wing and religious bloc secured 53, leaving both short of the 61 needed for a parliamentary majority. Arab-led parties, representing Palestinian citizens of Israel, won a record 19 seats.

Eisenkot has ruled out forming a government with the Arab-led parties, which would give him a 67-seat bloc. Winning over the two ultra-Orthodox parties, United Torah Judaism and Shas, would give him exactly 61 seats.
He could also form a government with fewer than 61 seats if he wins a parliamentary confidence vote.

Al Jazeera’s Nour Odeh, reporting from Ramallah in the occupied West Bank on Herzog’s decision, said the president “took the predictable route” in selecting Eisenkot, as he had the highest number of recommendations.

“The hard work will begin now for Eisenkot to put together a government that can pass a vote of confidence at the Knesset that: one, will not break too many of the promises he made on the campaign trail; and two, that can survive the opposition of the right-wing bloc led by Netanyahu,” Odeh said.

If Eisenkot fails to form a government within the allotted time, Herzog will nominate another candidate. If the second nominee fails, a parliament majority can back a third candidate, who will be granted a final 14 days.
If, once again, no government is formed, a new election will be called within 90 days, with Netanyahu staying on as a caretaker prime minister.
Eisenkot led Israel’s military from 2015 to 2019 and sat as an observer in Netanyahu’s war cabinet for the first eight months of Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza, which began in October 2023.
Ahmad Tibi, a senior member of the Joint List – a coalition of Arab-led parties that holds 11 seats – told Al Jazeera on Saturday that Herzog’s decision was “expected”.
“We were concerned that the president would move towards a national unity government,” he said, referring to a proposed power-sharing agreement between Eisenkot and Netanyahu.

列表 3（共 3 名） 以色列努力组建政府，赫尔佐格总统面临关键选择
在 10 月 27 日大选中双方均未获得多数席位后，赫尔佐格本周与各政党进行了磋商，以决定他将任命谁来组建政府。
大约 67 名议员（包括阿拉伯领导的政党）支持亚沙尔党领袖艾森科特组建下一届政府，而只有 46 名议员支持现任总理内塔尼亚胡。
艾森科特将有 28 天的时间（可能会延长 14 天）来建立一个由议会 120 个席位中至少 61 个席位组成的联盟，这是组建政府的最低门槛。
在10月份的选举中，艾森科特的四党联盟赢得了48个席位，而内塔尼亚胡的右翼和宗教集团则获得了53个席位，两者均未达到议会多数席位所需的61个席位。代表以色列巴勒斯坦公民的阿拉伯领导的政党赢得了创纪录的 19 个席位。
艾森科特排除了与阿拉伯领导的政党组建政府的可能性，这将使他拥有 67 个席位。如果赢得联合托拉犹太教和沙斯这两个极端正统政党的支持，他将获得 61 个席位。
如果他赢得议会信任投票，他还可以组建一个席位少于61个席位的政府。
半岛电视台的努尔·奥迪从被占领的约旦河西岸拉马拉报道了赫尔佐格的决定，称总统选择艾森科特“采取了可预见的路线”，因为他收到的推荐数量最多。
奥德说：“艾森科特现在将开始艰苦的工作，组建一个能够在议会通过信任投票的政府：第一，不会违背他在竞选过程中做出的太多承诺；第二，能够抵御内塔尼亚胡领导的右翼集团的反对。”
如果艾森科特未能在规定时间内组建政府，赫尔佐格将提名另一位候选人。如果第二名候选人失败，议会多数可以支持第三名候选人，该候选人将获得最后 14 天的选举权。
如果再次没有组建​​政府，则将在 90 天内举行新的选举，内塔尼亚胡将继续担任看守总理。
艾森科特于 2015 年至 2019 年领导以色列军队，并在 2023 年 10 月开始的以色列对加沙的种族灭绝战争的前八个月内担任内塔尼亚胡战时内阁观察员。
联合名单（由阿拉伯领导的政党组成的联盟，拥有 11 个席位）的高级成员艾哈迈德·提比 (Ahmad Tibi) 周六告诉半岛电视台，赫尔佐格的决定是“意料之中的”。
“我们担心总统会走向民族团结政府，”他说，指的是艾森科特和内塔尼亚胡之间拟议的权力分享协议。

title_en: How did AIPAC-backed candidates fare in the US midterm elections?
title_zh: AIPAC支持的候选人在美国中期选举中表现如何？
summary: Many candidates the pro-Israel group backed still won, but most of the money it spent went to candidates who lost.
summary_zh: 亲以色列团体支持的许多候选人仍然获胜，但其花费的大部分资金都流向了失败的候选人。
body_en: Share How did AIPAC-backed candidates fare in the US midterm elections? on social media

Nearly a year before he stunned many by winning a seat in the United States Senate from Texas, James Talarico drew attention for his vehement rejection of campaign funding from the country’s largest pro-Israel lobbying group, the American Israel Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC).

“I’ve never taken money from AIPAC, and I’m not taking money from AIPAC in this campaign,” Talarico said in a clip for a podcast that later went viral. “Seeing what’s happening in Gaza makes me sick to my stomach as a teacher, as a Christian, as a human being.”

list 2 of 3 Why did Democrat Haley Stevens just endorse a Republican for US Senate?
list 3 of 3 Could the US midterms further isolate Israel in Washington?

On November 3, Talarico won by more than 12 percentage points. Pro-Israel groups allied with AIPAC gave modest support – about $6,000 – to Talarico’s opponent, Ken Paxton, but Talarico’s willingness to be so open about his disdain for AIPAC is still a notable part of a shift in US politics.

In races across the country, AIPAC and political spending groups linked to it poured tens of millions of dollars into backing one candidate or another. While the group did back many winning candidates, nearly two-thirds of the total money it spent this election cycle went to those who ended up losing.
Even among Republicans, candidates are thinking twice about taking funds from the group, said Rina Shah, a geopolitical adviser and strategist and a former senior GOP congressional aide.

“A few years ago, taking AIPAC support was a no-brainer for most GOP candidates,” she told Al Jazeera. “Now, with a younger, more America First wing asking hard questions about foreign entanglements, and Gaza weighing on voters across the spectrum, it’s become a real topic, not a niche one.”

How AIPAC spends money has become more opaque . In October, for instance, the group said it would stop endorsing candidates and making direct contributions to them after this election cycle. Much of its spending already runs through affiliated political action committees, such as its super PAC, the United Democracy Project (UDP), making donations harder to track.

AIPAC has funded hundreds of candidates in the midterm elections, in both primaries and the general election on November 3, according to Track AIPAC, an organisation that records the group’s funding of US politicians. The organisation tabulates spending by UDP as well as nearly 50 other PACs tied to the pro-Israel lobbying group.

On November 4, the day after the Democratic Party roundly defeated Republicans and won control of both the House and Senate, AIPAC said it had already counted some 234 candidates it backed, from both parties, as having won their contests.

In terms of the number of winning candidates, the group still has a strong record. Pro-Israel groups like AIPAC and UDP backed candidates in at least 32 of 35 Senate races this election, according to Track AIPAC. In 26 of those races, the groups spent more than $100,000 on a candidate, and 21 of those candidates won their races on November 3.

“AIPAC members are determined to expand their political activism in the cycles ahead,” the group said in a post on X that specifically pointed to support for the two most powerful Democrats in Congress – Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer and House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries – who have also continued to call for maintaining strong US ties with Israel.

But nearly two-thirds of the total money pro-Israel groups spent in the midterm elections went to candidates who lost, according to a tally by the Quincy Institute for Responsible Statecraft. Around $55m of the $84m that AIPAC, UDP and linked groups spent in the election cycle went to candidates who did not win, according to the findings.

“We have entered a new era,” said Trita Parsi, executive vice president of the Quincy Institute, a foreign policy think tank that advocates for less US foreign involvement. “It is not just that AIPAC is spending millions of dollars and losing. You also have a new reality now in which candidates find AIPAC’s donations toxic and are rejecting it.”

The most notable race in which an AIPAC-backed candidate lost was for a Senate seat in Michigan, where the group and affiliated PACs spent some $30m on Representative Haley Stevens, a Democrat who unsuccessfully sought the party’s nomination for the contest. According to the New York Times, AIPAC then poured an additional $9m into backing Republican Mike Rogers, who lost on November 3 to Abdul El-Sayed, an outspoken critic of Israel who has called for the US to stop giving financial support to the country.
“Thank you for giving me the opportunity to beat you twice,” El-Sayed said in his victory speech on election night, addressing the pro-Israel lobbying group.
In Maine, AIPAC-linked groups gave more than $4.8m in support of Senator Susan Collins’s re-election campaign. Collins lost to Democrat Troy Jackson, who flipped a seat long held by Republicans.
body_zh: 分享 AIPAC 支持的候选人在美国中期选举中表现如何？在社交媒体上
近一年前，詹姆斯·塔拉里科 (James Talarico) 从德克萨斯州赢得美国参议院席位，震惊了许多人，他因强烈拒绝美国最大的亲以色列游说团体——美国以色列公共事务委员会 (AIPAC) 的竞选资金而引起关注。
“我从来没有从 AIPAC 那里拿过钱，在这次竞选活动中我也不会从 AIPAC 那里拿钱，”塔拉里科在后来疯传的播客片段中说道。 “作为一名教师、一名基督徒、作为一个人，看到加沙发生的事情让我感到恶心。”
3 项清单 3 项清单 1 贾马尔·鲍曼：“如果我闭嘴，我就会进入国会”
list 2 of 3 为什么民主党人 Haley Stevens 刚刚支持共和党人竞选美国参议员？
list 3 of 3 美国中期选举会在华盛顿进一步孤立以色列吗？
11 月 3 日，塔拉里科以超过 12 个百分点获胜。与 AIPAC 结盟的亲以色列团体向塔拉里科的对手肯·帕克斯顿提供了约 6,000 美元的适度支持，但塔拉里科愿意如此公开地表达他对 AIPAC 的蔑视，这仍然是美国政治转变的一个值得注意的部分。
在全国各地的竞选中，AIPAC 和与之相关的政治支出团体投入了数千万美元来支持一位或另一位候选人。虽然该组织确实支持了许多获胜的候选人，但本次选举周期花费的总资金中近三分之二都流向了那些最终落败的候选人。
地缘政治顾问和战略家、前共和党国会高级助理丽娜·沙阿 (Rina Shah) 表示，即使在共和党人中，候选人也会在从该组织获取资金时三思而后行。
“几年前，对于大多数共和党候选人来说，获得 AIPAC 的支持是理所当然的事情，”她告诉半岛电视台。 “现在，随着更年轻、更加美国第一的派系对外国纠葛提出尖锐的问题，加沙对各个阶层的选民产生了压力，这已经成为一个真正的话题，而不是一个小众话题。”
AIPAC 的花钱方式变得更加不透明。例如，该组织在 10 月份表示，在本次选举周期结束后，将停止支持候选人并向他们直接捐款。它的大部分支出已经通过附属政治行动委员会进行，例如其超级政治行动委员会、联合民主项目（UDP），这使得捐款更难追踪。
据记录 AIPAC 资助美国政客情况的组织 Track AIPAC 的数据，AIPAC 已在中期选举、初选和 11 月 3 日大选中资助了数百名候选人。该组织列出了 UDP 以及与亲以色列游说团体相关的近 50 个其他 PAC 的支出。
11 月 4 日，即民主党全面击败共和党并赢得参众两院控制权的第二天，AIPAC 表示，它已统计出其支持的两党约 234 名候选人赢得了竞选。
从获胜候选人的数量来看，该小组仍然保持着强劲的记录。据 Track AIPAC 称，AIPAC 和 UDP 等亲以色列团体在本次选举的 35 场参议院竞选中至少支持了 32 场候选人。在其中 26 场比赛中，这些团体在一名候选人身上花费了超过 10 万美元，其中 21 名候选人在 11 月 3 日赢得了比赛。
该组织在 X 上发表的一篇文章中表示，“AIPAC 成员决心在未来的周期中扩大其政治活动”，其中特别指出了对国会中两位最有权势的民主党人——参议院少数党领袖查克·舒默和众议院少数党领袖哈基姆·杰弗里斯——的支持，他们也继续呼吁维持美国与以色列的牢固关系。
但根据昆西负责任治国研究所的统计，亲以色列团体在中期选举中花费的总资金中近三分之二都流向了失败的候选人。调查结果显示，AIPAC、UDP 和相关团体在选举周期中花费的 8400 万美元中，约有 5500 万美元流向了未获胜的候选人。
“我们已经进入了一个新时代，”主张减少美国对外参与的外交政策智库昆西研究所执行副所长特里塔·帕西说。 “AIPAC 不仅花费了数百万美元并遭受损失。现在还面临着一个新的现实，候选人发现 AIPAC 的捐款有毒并拒绝它。”

AIPAC 支持的候选人输掉的最引人注目的一场竞选是密歇根州的参议院席位竞选，该组织和附属的 PAC 在密歇根州参议院席位的竞选中花费了约 3000 万美元购买民主党众议员海莉·史蒂文斯 (Haley Stevens)，但她未能成功寻求该党的提名。据《纽约时报》报道，AIPAC 随后追加投入 900 万美元支持共和党人迈克·罗杰斯 (Mike Rogers)，罗杰斯于 11 月 3 日输给了直言不讳的以色列批评者阿卜杜勒·埃尔·赛义德 (Abdul El-Sayed)，他呼吁美国停止向该国提供财政支持。
“感谢你们给了我两次击败你们的机会，”埃尔赛义德在选举之夜的胜利演讲中对亲以色列游说团体说道。
在缅因州，AIPAC 相关团体捐赠了超过 480 万美元来支持参议员苏珊·柯林斯的连任竞选。柯林斯输给了民主党人特洛伊·杰克逊，后者推翻了共和党长期占据的席位。
